description:
Add a `handle_info({:cell_update, subscriber, projected}, socket)` clause inside the `use Filament.LiveView` macro injection (`lib/filament/live_view.ex` near the existing `:filament_observable_updates` clause around line 206) and the matching path in `lib/filament/live_component.ex`'s `process_filament_msg/3` (current clauses at ~145/163/186, catch-all at ~202).

Decode subscriber tuple `{owner_pid, fiber_id, slot_index}` (the shape that `Filament.Hooks.cell_subscribe_fresh/3` passes to `Filament.Cell.subscribe`, hooks.ex:416). Look up the fiber slot, write `{:cell_subscribed, projected}`, and trigger a re-render via the same path the `:filament_observable_updates` handler uses today.

Add a LV-level integration test that proves a real `use_cell` subscription flows end-to-end through the LV process (the existing `test/filament/hooks/use_cell_test.exs` only asserts message delivery to a test pid).

Done when: a component using `use_cell` re-renders on observable change in a Phoenix.LiveViewTest scenario.
title: Wire :cell_update into LiveView and LiveComponent
